title: Lagrange interpolation
summary:
Constructs a polynomial of degree through given points.
Points can be added by clicking on "Add point".
The dotted line is the graph of the first derivative, the dashed line is the graph of the second derivative.

steps.title: Lagrange interpolation
steps.detail: Constructs a polynomial of degree through given points. Points can be added by clicking on "Add point". The dotted line is the graph of the first derivative, the dashed line is the graph of the second derivative.

steps.title: Interact
steps.detail: Drag free points, gliders, and sliders on the board to see how the figure updates.
